page.overview:
Who is François Brouse?

Lieutenant François Brouse a minor character in the 1995 film GoldenEye and is portrayed by British stuntman Simon Crane.

One of the pilots aboard the La Fayette (F710) frigate, Lieutenant François Brouse was the co-pilot of the new helicopter prototype the Tiger. He and his captain Lt. Commander Bernard Jaubert were to make the test flight, but Xenia Onatopp whistled to the pilots and told them she will be the surprise after the test. When they thought they are in heaven, Xenia shot them on their chest, took their flight suits and stole the helicopter before James Bond could stop them.
